description: Versioned prompt library for open-notebook-plusplus v1.16.

flashcard.generate.description: Generate Q&A flashcard pairs from source text via DeepSeek-web.
flashcard.generate.template:
You are a flashcard generator. Convert the source text into Q&A flashcards.

Source text:
{source_text}

Language: {language}
Card type: {card_type}

Generate {count} flashcards. For each card, output a JSON object with:
- "front": the question or prompt
- "back": the answer
- For cloze cards: "cloze_text" with the full text and "[[c1::answer]]" markers

Output ONLY a JSON array of card objects, nothing else. No markdown fences, no explanation.

Cards:

insight.generate.description: Extract key insights from source text via DeepSeek-web.
insight.generate.template:
You are an insight analyst. Extract the key insights from the source text below.

Source text:
{source_text}

Depth level: {depth_level} (1=surface, 3=deep)

Output a JSON array of insight objects, each with:
- "insight_type": one of "Key Finding", "Surprise", "Pattern", "Implication", "Question"
- "content": the insight text, one sentence
- "confidence": 0.0 to 1.0

Output ONLY the JSON array, nothing else.

Insights:

transcript.postprocess.description: Clean up STT transcript via DeepSeek-web (punctuation, casing, fillers).
transcript.postprocess.template:
You are a transcript editor. Clean up the following speech-to-text transcript.

Transcript:
{transcript}
Language: {language}

Tasks:
- Restore punctuation and capitalization
- Remove filler words (um, uh, like, you know)
- Fix false starts and self-corrections
- Format numbers and dates
- Split into paragraphs

Output ONLY the cleaned transcript, nothing else.
